modification: Added only a marked hosting notice and its styles, with public-demo context, attribution, and evidence links. Removing the notice recovers the original report byte for byte.
scope: Static saved public report and aggregate session CSV. Includes bounded derived sample previews, not raw recordings, model binaries, or full prediction/label bundles.
localization_rule: Largest positive net added squared error in 24 consecutive scored samples; whole session if shorter; earliest exact tie.
scoring_preservation: All result fields except comparator_source_digest are identical to the prior saved public replay; original bundle unchanged. No refit or inference.
